x: George Piddington and Ben Lulham were old campaigners; had they prevented the rape of Evelyn Stimpson?- would we ever see her smile again? We had lost Bernard Merry in the first few seconds - of this I was convinced and had crossed myself earlier.

We all departed on Sunday evening after a "restful" week-end,in general agreement that it had been most enjoyable,and we would like to express our gratitude to Charlie Manning for his hard work in organizing this trip. Evelyn Stimpson.

Through the gossamer veils of memory come the gentleness of Evelyn Stimpson and the pleasure of seeing Wynn Shepherd, of the American Belgravian Edmund Donovan and his wife, who flew in, specially for the occasion, from New York.
Evelyn Stimpson, mainspring in so many ventures, grafting away with needle and thread or paintbrushes or pottery, forever helpful and understanding.
Thank you all, and in particular that small hard core who've made it possible - Gordon Biscoe, John Baker, Evelyn Stimpson and my daughter Linda, who have done more for this office than I have.

Let us not forget Tom Carter (transport), Evelyn Stimpson (facia), Arthur Penny (scaffolding) and the ever present Bob Taylor. It was a great effort that payed off - and it paid off to the tune of £241.30 gross to give us a net profit of £143.97.

Well done Ted and Evelyn Stimpson - organisers supreme. Official guests were His Worshipful the Mayor of the London Borough of Merton, Councillor B.N.Clifford, and Chief Superintendant E.M.Pitts of 'V' division whose long suffering constables put up with the traffic chaos when we hold our Belgrave '20' and road relays.

Jenny and John Martin travelled all the way from Gloucestershire and Jenny's many Belgrave friends were delighted to see that she is now recovering from a period in hospital. Evelyn and Ted Stimpson were also official guests - a fitting honour in the year when Ted is honoured as President of the Middlesex AAA's.
